results.title: Uptime Monitoring, Status Pages & On-Call | Hyperping
results.snippet: Hyperping plans start at $29/month with flat-rate pricing. You pay based on the number of monitors, not the number of team members. Every plan includes status pages, on-call scheduling, multi-channel alerts, and multi-region monitoring.

results.title: UptimeRobot Pricing (2026): Plans, Add-Ons and Real Cost
results.snippet: Hyperping's Essentials plan is $29 a month, or $24 annually, with 30-second checks on 50 monitors, a status page on your own domain, phone call alerts and on-call schedules included.
